summary: Diff adds more robust trailer modal state handling (separate selectedMedia/isDialogOpen, delayed media clear), keyed iframe remounts to stop playback and avoid blank reopens, explicit error vs no-trailer states with retry, and development-only diagnostics hooks. Global CSS includes stated Radix Dialog z-index fixes but also broad visual restyling.

hallucinated_features.description: Broad UI/visual redesign changes (animated gradient background, neon/glass styling, custom scrollbar, extensive color token changes) beyond what is necessary to make the trailer modal visible/functional.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest non-goal explicitly discourages redesigning the app UI beyond what is needed for the trailer modal reliability; the diff includes extensive global styling changes not directly tied to trailer loading reliability.

hallucinated_features.description: Global React Query default option changes (refetchOnWindowFocus false, retry 2) applied at runtime in App.
hallucinated_features.reason: Not requested by any REQ; could affect broader app data-fetch behavior beyond trailer flow.
